pages.estimate_scope: Main page with figures/code and thought; optional reading and execution costs are not added to this preserved estimate.

limitations: Expert whole-book reread by one AI task; not a human novice learning study and not350 strict paragraph-blind first reads.
341 pages used full-page frozen main text, at most3 per batch; only9 assigned pages used reader.py unit gating.

5.8 final placeholder checkpoint was rejected, then5.9–5.11 were exposed before administrative closure. Substantive5.8 units0–2 were recorded first. This trace is not clean strict page closure; the incident is not cured by this report.
9.8 unit0 schema retry happened before any later unit; original rejected attempt and retry both remain.

Shared filesystem isolation was by rules, not physical access controls. No author project-context, historical review, git diff/log, author-private/coordinator files, other round workdirs or peer results were read.
350 main pages were finished before any details;261 details pages/277 blocks were then read. Later clarification is not retroactively counted as initial understanding.
All115 unique frozen SVGs were rendered and actually viewed; actual responsive desktop/mobile website layout, navigation and overlays were not inspected.
CairoSVG missing glyphs, unavailable default Chromium and blocked file URLs were tool failures; final SVG rendering used system Chromium with unchanged SVG content and local CJK fallback.
Two page-reading output truncations were recorded and recovered by pagewise rereading. Exposure timestamps are not treated as proof of reading or viewing.

No notebook/model examples were executed, no training/GPU/paid API/downloads were run, and external papers or live API claims were not independently validated. Findings assess explanation and evidence scope, not technical replication.
Two literal-quote errors and one optional-summary wording error remain in original notes with separate hash-bound errata. Derived final quotations use the corrected source wording.
AI reading-time estimates exclude installation, downloading, actual training, execution waiting and extra prerequisite study; they are estimates rather than observed human times.
